statement_html:
Werk de haakjes weg en schrijf zo eenvoudig mogelijk \(- 4 \left(- 2 x + 5\right)\).
Jouw antwoord :
\(- 4 \left(- 2 x + 5\right) =\) .
solution_html:
\({\color{green}} -4 {\color{black}} ({\color{blue}} - 2 x {\color{purple}}+ 5 {\color{black}} )\) = \({\color{green}}\char40 -4 \char41{\color{black}}\times {\color{blue}}\char40 - 2 x \char41{\color{black}}\) + \({\color{green}}\char40 -4 \char41{\color{black}} \times {\color{purple}}\char40 5 \char41{\color{black}}\)
= \(8 x\) + \(\left(-20\right)\)
= \(8 x - 20\)
